specs.step3_feature_fertility_window:
df['days_since_lmp'] = (df['DateTesting'] - df['StartDateofLastPeriod']).dt.days
cycle_len = df['ReportedCycleLength'].fillna(28)
df['days_to_ovulation'] = cycle_len - 14
df['days_from_ovulation'] = df['days_since_lmp'] - df['days_to_ovulation']
df['high_fertility'] = ((df['days_from_ovulation'] >= -3) & (df['days_from_ovulation'] <= 3)).astype(int)
df['low_fertility'] = ((df['days_from_ovulation'] >= 10) & (df['days_from_ovulation'] <= 17)).astype(int)
specs.step5_model_interaction:
import statsmodels.api as sm
import numpy as np
if 'religiosity' not in df.columns or 'high_fertility' not in df.columns or 'low_fertility' not in df.columns or 'committed' not in df.columns:
    raise ValueError('Required columns missing from df')
df['fertility_contrast'] = df['high_fertility'] - df['low_fertility']
df['interaction'] = df['fertility_contrast'] * df['committed']
X = df[['fertility_contrast', 'committed', 'interaction']]
X = sm.add_constant(X)
y = df['religiosity']
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit(cov_type='HC3')
est = model.params['interaction']
ci_low = model.conf_int(alpha=0.05).loc['interaction', 0]
ci_high = model.conf_int(alpha=0.05).loc['interaction', 1]
p_val = model.pvalues['interaction']
return {'estimate': est, 'ci_low': ci_low, 'ci_high': ci_high, 'p_value': p_val}

df['DaysSinceLastPeriod'] = (df['DateTesting'] - df['StartDateofLastPeriod']).dt.days
cycle_len = df['ReportedCycleLength'].fillna(28.0)
df['EstimatedOvulation'] = df['StartDateofLastPeriod'] + pd.to_timedelta(cycle_len / 2, unit='D')
df['DaysToOvulation'] = (df['EstimatedOvulation'] - df['DateTesting']).dt.days
high_mask = (df['DaysToOvulation'] >= 1) & (df['DaysToOvulation'] <= 5)
low_mask = (df['DaysToOvulation'] >= 8) & (df['DaysToOvulation'] <= 14)
df['fertility_status'] = np.where(high_mask, 'high', np.where(low_mask, 'low', 'other'))
specs.step4_feature_relationship: df['relationship_group'] = df['Relationship'].apply(lambda x: 'committed' if x >= 2 else 'single')
specs.step5_model_interaction:
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
model = smf.ols('religiosity ~ C(fertility_status, Treatment(reference="low")) * C(relationship_group, Treatment(reference="single"))', data=df).fit(cov_type='HC3')
coef = model.params.get('C(fertility_status, Treatment(reference="low"))[T.high]:C(relationship_group, Treatment(reference="single"))[T.committed]', 0.0)
ci = model.conf_int(cov_type='HC3').loc['C(fertility_status, Treatment(reference="low"))[T.high]:C(relationship_group, Treatment(reference="single"))[T.committed]']
p = model.pvalues.get('C(fertility_status, Treatment(reference="low"))[T.high]:C(relationship_group, Treatment(reference="single"))[T.committed]', 1.0)
ctx['estimate'] = float(coef)
ctx['ci_low'] = float(ci[0]) if len(ci) > 0 else 0.0
ctx['ci_high'] = float(ci[1]) if len(ci) > 1 else 0.0
ctx['p_value'] = float(p)
